topic: Is there an animal-share target in school meals?
claim_a: Part VI: school meals are guided by a target to raise animal protein above 40% of protein (Decision 1340/QĐ-TTg) [CHN-33]
claim_b: Actor check: current guidance (Decision 3958/QĐ-BYT) has no animal share [AIB-39; APR-04]
position_taken: Both partly right: national guidance has no animal share and the 1340 targets ended in 2020, but the MOET, Ajinomoto and NIN menu software prints an animal-protein standard of at least 48%, which 9 of 25 published days miss [PMR-26]
notes: The operative signal is a software default, not a rule

claim_a: Press: the programme scales a MOET, NIN and TH Group model with 400 standard menus and one carton of fresh milk a day [AFN-45]
claim_b: Decision text: scale up the school meal model with menus meeting the preschool programme and MOH guidance; no company, menu count or milk named [PMR-01]
position_taken: Attribute the menu count and milk to the press report, not to the decision
notes: Both may be true; the decision leaves the model to MOET

position_taken: Use 2026 (the number series and the school year point to 2026); the day is uncertain
notes: Typo in one of two primary documents

topic: Share of daily energy in a primary school lunch
claim_a: Decision 3958/QĐ-BYT: 30 to 40% [AIB-39]; menu software 532.5 to 710 kcal [PMR-26]
claim_b: Hai Phong school tender: 35 to 40%, 560 to 720 kcal [PMR-07]
position_taken: Report both; local tenders can be tighter than national guidance

claim_a: VND 20,000 (self-organised) or 25,000 (hired caterer) in regions I and II; VND 18,000 or 22,000 in regions III and IV [AIB-43]
claim_b: Re-read of the same page: VND 20,000 and above (regions I and II) and VND 18,000 and above (regions III and IV) [AIB-43, re-read]
position_taken: Keep the 20,000 and 18,000 floors as confirmed; treat the hired-caterer floors as unconfirmed
notes: Re-read was through a summarising fetch tool

claim_a: Part VI ladder: 15 g per 100 g (literature on commercial fillets) [DIE-13; DIE-14]
claim_b: Decision 3958 food table: 9.7 g per 100 g [AIB-39]
